observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive gearbox with attached fluid lines and a red cap.
Photo 1 shows the same gearbox with a black harness and a red cap.

The photos show the gearbox casing and some lines, but internal components are not visible.
No part number is legible on the gearbox in the photos.
Internal condition and cleanliness cannot be determined from external photos.

risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being manually rotated or a photo of the internal casing.
A photo of the part number stamped on the gearbox casing.

risks.risk: Missing internal components like the input/output shafts
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox with the casing open.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped part number on the gearbox casing.
Video of the gearbox being turned by hand to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the internal components to confirm they are present.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
